title: AGENTS.md
text: Dependencies: Imports httr2, jsonlite, S7, rlang, cli, tibble (plus base stats/utils). Add new ones strong reason; test-packages go Suggests. S7: classes declared package = "typesafer". Constructors normalize input raise typesafer_error_input via abort_input(); validators return string (NULL) also run @<-. S7::methods_register() called .onLoad(). typesafer_error_auth: missing key 401 typesafer_error_validation: 422, details tibble typesafer_error_rate_limit: 429 529 typesafer_error_server: 5xx also inherit typesafer_error_http typesafer_error_connection: response cli messages: {?s} pluralization, pass count explicitly {cli::qty(length(x))}. Wrap .data {(.data)}. Shared columns: system_one_df() as_tibble(<ts_response>) must produce identical columns. Change R/columns.R, keep test compares passing. Defaults Python SDK takes environment come helper functions: ts_api_key() (TYPESAFE_API_KEY) ts_default_model() (TYPESAFE_DEFAULT_MODEL). local_ts_env() clears , plus TYPESAFE_BASE_URL, mock fixtures match. Retries mirror Python SDK: 408, 429 5xx plus connection failures; max_tries = 3; 30s budget; backoff 0.5s doubling 5s 25% jitter; retry--ms retry-. Keep HTTP error handling httr2, req_perform_parallel() retries responses treats errors. Scores stay API’s 0-based scale. Never shift 1-based.

title: AGENTS.md
text: request bodies go ts_json() (auto_unbox = TRUE, null = "null"), sent httr2::req_body_raw(), tests can assert exact bytes. Choice options without description must serialize null, never {}. Use x[] <- list(NULL) keep (x[[]] <- NULL drops ). Score criteria must always JSON array: keep unnamed list. Noul criteria keys strings "true" "false". Score probabilities legend arrive keyed "0", "1", . Order numerically (by_level()), lexically, "10" sorts "2".

title: Unofficial Client for the TypeSafe System One API
text: package experimental. learn Jev System One API work (state, question types, confidence, patterns), read official TypeSafe docs. typesafer brings TypeSafe’s typed, calibrated decisions R. ’s unofficial client TypeSafe System One API. send piece state (text structured data) set typed questions, get back calibrated probabilities code can act : ts_noul(): yes/questions. answer probability yes. ts_choice(): pick one 255 options. answer chosen option, probability every option, confidence. ts_score(): rate 2 10 ordered levels. answer probability-weighted level, probability every level, confidence. typesafer isn’t affiliated endorsed TypeSafe.

title: Unofficial Client for the TypeSafe System One API
text: Ask several questions one piece state single request: Printing response gives one-line summary per answer: work answers data, convert response one-row tibble. columns system_one_df() adds, : Scores use API’s 0-based scale. levels c("low", "medium", "high"), score near 2 means "high". full distribution ordered level. API rounds probabilities reports, may reproduce score exactly: Choice options can carry descriptions, instructions, options, levels can structured lists:
code: library(typesafer)  resp <- system_one(   "I was charged twice. Please help ASAP.",   billing = ts_noul("Is this about billing?"),   tone    = ts_choice("What is the tone?", c("calm", "angry")),   urgency = ts_score("How urgent is this?", c("low", "medium", "high")) )  resp@answers$billing@prob #> [1] 0.98 resp@answers$tone@choice #> [1] "angry" resp@answers$urgency@score #> [1] 1.89 resp #> <ts_response> jev-1.13.0 | 346 input / 65 output tokens #>   billing noul   0.98 #>   tone    choice "angry"    (confidence 0.97) #>   urgency score  1.89 [0-2] (confidence 0.83) as_tibble(resp, include_usage = TRUE) #> # A tibble: 1 × 7 #>   billing tone  tone_confidence urgency urgency_confidence input_tokens output_tokens #>     <dbl> <chr>           <dbl>   <dbl>              <dbl>        <int>         <int> #> 1    0.98 angry            0.97    1.89               0.83          346            65 resp@answers$urgency@probabilities #> [1] 0.00 0.11 0.89 ts_choice(   "Which team should handle this?",   c(     billing   = "Payments, invoicing, refunds",     technical = "Bugs, outages, integrations",     sales     = "Pricing, upgrades, new accounts"   ) ) #> <ts_choice> Which team should handle this? #>   billing:   Payments, invoicing, refunds #>   technical: Bugs, outages, integrations #>   sales:     Pricing, upgrades, new accounts  ts_noul(   "Does this convey urgency?",   c(true = "Explicitly time-sensitive", false = "No urgency expressed") ) #> <ts_noul> Does this convey urgency? #>   true:  Explicitly time-sensitive #>   false: No urgency expressed

title: Unofficial Client for the TypeSafe System One API
text: system_one_df() sends one request per row, every question batched request, runs requests parallel. returns input tibble answer columns added: Set probs = TRUE also get choice score probability distribution list-column, include_usage = TRUE add token counts. Use on_error = "continue" keep rows succeeded requests fail. Failed rows get NA answers errors go .error column.
code: tickets <- tibble::tibble(   id = 1:3,   text = c(     "Please cancel my subscription and refund this month.",     "How do I export my data to CSV?",     "Your app crashed and I lost an hour of work!!"   ) )  system_one_df(   tickets,   state = text,   billing = ts_noul("Is this about billing?"),   tone    = ts_choice("What is the tone?", c("calm", "angry")),   urgency = ts_score("How urgent is this?", c("low", "medium", "high")) ) #> # A tibble: 3 × 7 #>      id text                      billing tone  tone_confidence urgency urgency_confidence #>   <int> <chr>                       <dbl> <chr>           <dbl>   <dbl>              <dbl> #> 1     1 Please cancel my subscri…    0.97 calm             0.93    1.2                0.53 #> 2     2 How do I export my data …    0.05 calm             1       0.07               0.9  #> 3     3 Your app crashed and I l…    0.05 angry            1       1.85               0.78

TypeSafe API rejected the API key (HTTP 401). #> ✖ Cannot authenticate with the server. Please check your API key and try again. #> ℹ Check the key passed to `api_key`. #> ℹ Request ID: req_01a0fe2b81f4766cba5f03818358ac9b tryCatch(   system_one("Hi", q = ts_noul("Is this a greeting?"), model = "no-such-model"),   typesafer_error_rate_limit = function(err) NULL,   typesafer_error_http = function(err) err$status ) #> [1] 400

text: state content evaluate: single string, list structured data record chat log (named list becomes JSON object, unnamed list JSON array). See https://docs.typesafe.ai/concepts/state. ... Named questions created ts_noul(), ts_choice(), ts_score(). names identify answers shown model. can also splice named list questions !!!. model model use. Defaults ts_default_model(), "jev-latest", TypeSafe's flagship model, unless TYPESAFE_DEFAULT_MODEL environment variable says otherwise. Pin versioned ID "jev-1.13.0" keep answers stable. title: Ask System One questions about every row of a data frame — system_one_df
text: .data data frame. state <data-masking> expression evaluated .data giving state row: usually character column (state = text), expression paste(subject, body, sep = "\n\n"), list-column holding one structured state (list) per row. ... Named questions created ts_noul(), ts_choice(), ts_score(). names identify answers shown model. can also splice named list questions !!!. model model use. Defaults ts_default_model(), "jev-latest", TypeSafe's flagship model, unless TYPESAFE_DEFAULT_MODEL environment variable says otherwise. Pin versioned ID "jev-1.13.0" keep answers stable. See ts_models(). probs TRUE, also add <name>_probs list-column choice score question holding full probability distribution. include_usage TRUE, also add input_tokens output_tokens columns row's token usage (NA failed rows). max_active Maximum number requests flight . on_error row's request fails retries: "stop" (default): stop sending requests raise error first failed row (see typesafer_error); condition row field. "continue": finish every row, fill answers failed rows NA, add .error list-column holding row's error (NULL), warn count failed rows. max_tries Maximum number attempts per request, including first. Requests fail 408, 429, 5xx, connection failure retried exponential backoff, within 30 second retry budget. Use 1 disable retries. timeout Timeout attempt, seconds. Defaults typesafer.timeout option, 10. api_key API key; defaults ts_api_key().

title: Question types — ts_question
text: TypeSafe questions come three types: ts_noul(): yes/question. answer probability answer yes. ts_choice(): pick one option set 255. answer chosen option, probability every option, confidence. ts_score(): rate 2 10 ordered levels. answer probability-weighted level (0-based, can land levels), probability every level, confidence. Pass questions system_one() system_one_df() named arguments; names identify answers.

title: Question types — ts_question
code: ts_noul(instructions, criteria = NULL)  ts_choice(instructions, criteria)  ts_score(instructions, criteria)

title: Question types — ts_question
text: instructions question ask. Either single string, list structured instructions (named list becomes JSON object, unnamed list JSON array). See https://docs.typesafe.ai/primitives/advanced. criteria answers mean: ts_noul(): optional descriptions yes , named character vector list names true /false, e.g. c(true = "Explicitly time-sensitive", false = "urgency expressed"). ts_choice(): options. Either bare character vector option names (c("calm", "angry")), named character vector list mapping option description. Unnamed elements, NA, NULL descriptions sent options description (null). ts_score(): ordered levels, lowest first, character vector list structured descriptions. Level reported score - 1.

title: Answer and response types — ts_response
text: system_one() returns ts_response holding one answer per question: ts_answer_noul: @prob, probability (0 1) answer yes. Nouls separate confidence. ts_answer_choice: @choice, highest-probability option; @probabilities, named double vector one probability per option; @confidence. ts_answer_score: @score, probability-weighted level, API's 0-based scale (levels c("low", "medium", "high"), 1.8 close "high"); @probabilities, double vector ordered level, element probability level - 1; @legend, level descriptions order; @confidence. Confidence runs 0 1 summarizes concentrated probability distribution . See https://docs.typesafe.ai/confidence. ts_response also keeps parsed response body @json, can reach fields typesafer model yet (including answers question types recognize). structure follows API may change.

title: Errors — typesafer_error
text: Every error raised typesafer inherits typesafer_error, can catch tryCatch(..., typesafer_error = ...). specific classes: typesafer_error_input: invalid arguments, detected request sent. typesafer_error_auth: API key missing, API rejected (HTTP 401). typesafer_error_http: unsuccessful HTTP response. fields status, response_body (parsed JSON, text, NULL), request_id, resp (httr2::response()). Subclasses: typesafer_error_auth: HTTP 401. typesafer_error_validation: HTTP 422. details field tibble one row per offending field (field, message, type). typesafer_error_rate_limit: HTTP 429 (rate limited) 529 (overloaded), retries exhausted. typesafer_error_server: 5xx responses, retries exhausted. typesafer_error_connection: request never got response (DNS, connection, timeout failure), retries exhausted. Requests fail 408, 429, 5xx, connection failure, retried exponential backoff (0.5s doubling 5s, jitter), within 30 second budget. default request tried 3 times; change max_tries argument. retry--ms retry-response headers honored.

title: typesafer 0.1.0
text: Choice criteria accept bare character vector options named vector list descriptions. Options without description sent JSON null. choice can 255 options. Score criteria take 2 10 ordered levels always sent JSON array. Noul criteria optionally describe true false mean. Instructions, options, levels accept strings structured lists.

title: typesafer 0.1.0
text: system_one() asks number named questions one state (string structured data) single request. returns ts_response typed answers, model answered, token usage. system_one_df() asks questions every row data frame, one request per row, run parallel httr2::req_perform_parallel(). adds probability column noul, value _confidence column choice score, optional _probs list-columns. on_error = "continue" keeps rows succeeded others fail. Score answers stay API’s 0-based scale, probabilities level descriptions returned vectors ordered level. ts_models() lists models available account.
